title: Proto-Gardener conformance harness for multipart toolcalls and streaming roundtrips
creator: Maya Patel
description: Build a focused conformance harness ("Proto-Gardener") that validates end-to-end behavior across streaming, function/tool calling, and structured-output schemas. The harness should exercise multipart/interleaved toolcall scenarios, partial responses, JSON-schema fallbacks, and KV-cache priming across model variants and runtime versions. Aim: quickly detect regressions that break downstream integrators (third-party tool adapters and customer on-prem gateways) and gate CI for release branches.
acceptance_criteria: A stable test harness repository (tests/proto-gardener) that can be executed locally and in CI with a single script
A vetted corpus of 250 golden seeds covering: interleaved streaming + toolcall permutations, nested structured outputs, partial-message recovery, and KV-cache priming paths
Automated contract checks that assert: event ordering, tool call identity preservation, JSON-schema validity or safe fallback text, and stream chunk reassembly correctness
CI jobs that run a fast smoke-suite on PRs and a nightly full-suite with coverage reports and behavioral diffs
Flaky thresholds defined: failures > 3% on nightly run must open a regression ticket and attach failing seed list
Documentation page with runbook, artifact links (GH PR, confluence test plan), and triage checklist
recent_updates: 2025-01-12: Spike completed — validated basic interleaved toolcall simulation against latest runtime-1.19 image (Maya).
2025-01-20: Chosen test framework: pytest + asyncio harness + ndjson recorder. Prototype harness that simulates partial chunks created (Lucas).
2025-01-27: Seed corpus initial import (120 seeds) from customer support reproductions and partner adapters. Added schema variants and fallback scenarios (Maya).
2025-02-02: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime-tests/pull/218 - adds CI smoke job and local runner; awaiting eng review (Lucas).
reproducible_steps: Checkout runtime-tests repo and switch to branch proto-gardener: git clone ... && git checkout proto-gardener
Run local harness with dockerized runtime: ./scripts/run_proto_gardener.sh --runtime-image runtime:1.19 --mode smoke
Observe ndjson trace at artifacts/latest/trace.ndjson and compare to golden/expected/*.ndjson using tests/compare_traces.py
To reproduce nightly failures, run full corpus: ./scripts/run_proto_gardener.sh --mode nightly --persist-failures
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: flakiness from integration timing differences (network jitter, serialization chunking) can produce false positives. Mitigation: isolate timing-dependent asserts, normalize timestamps and chunk boundaries in trace comparator, provide a deterministic stub runtime for unit-level checks, and maintain a tolerated-flaky-seed list in the repo.
notes: Design decision: use ndjson trace format to interleave structured events and make diffs human-readable.
Follow-up: add a minimal Java/Go adapter harness to validate cross-SDK toolcall binary encodings (post-MVP).
Ops ask: nightly job should upload failing seeds and stack traces to S3 and create a regression ticket template automatically.
